胡九郎指尖轻轻拂过骷髅头的表面，指尖传来一阵刺骨的阴冷。

“这骷髅头被人用阴邪术法炼制过，上面残留着莫奇卫的气息，却很微弱，应该是他故意留下的傀儡，目的就是引我们来这里，拖延时间，趁机脱身。”

李二牛也凑上前来，手里的铜钱晃动了几下，嘴里念念有词，随后摇了摇头，无奈道：

“他应该刚离开没多久，只是气息已经被彻底掩盖，我也感应不到他的具体去向了。”

杨童皱着眉，环顾整个破庙，神色愈发严肃。

“他故意引我们来破庙，就是为了争取时间逃跑，现在追踪器的信号消失，罗盘也无法定位，想要再找到他，确实难了。东北一带地域广阔，阴邪之地众多，他随便找个地方藏身，我们都很难发现。”

林佳看着那颗骷髅头，懊恼道：

“大意了，没有察觉到这是个陷阱，让他彻底跑了。”

胡九郎收起罗盘。

“现在我们没有任何线索，继续留在这废弃村落，也只是浪费时间。不如先找个地方安顿下来，一方面休息调整，另一方面再想办法寻找莫奇卫的踪迹。”

李二牛点了点头。

“没错，这附近有个青峰镇，离这里不算太远，我们可以先去青峰镇住下来，我再请仙长帮忙感应莫奇卫的大致方向，或许能有新的线索。”

杨童思索了片刻。

“也好，就先去青峰镇安顿。林佳，你和阡陌先去开车，我和胡九郎再在破庙周围查看一下，看看能不能找到一些莫奇卫留下的蛛丝马迹。”

林佳和阡陌点了点头，转身走出破庙去取车。

胡九郎和杨童在破庙内仔细搜查了一圈，无论是墙角的杂草，还是案几的缝隙都没有放过，可最终除了那颗骷髅头，没有找到任何有用的线索。

莫奇卫做事极为谨慎，几乎没有留下任何痕迹。

这时林佳和阡陌已经把车开了过来。胡九郎和杨童还有李二牛决定先去青峰镇再说，李二牛将骷髅头带走，几人上车之后，朝着青峰镇的方向驶去。

一路上众人都很沉默，没有了之前追击的紧张，只剩下寻踪无果的失落与凝重。

大约行驶了一个小时，车子终于抵达了青峰镇。

青峰镇不算大，却很热闹，街道两旁摆满了摊位，来往的行人络绎不绝，与之前荒凉的废弃村落截然不同。

李二牛熟门熟路地带着众人，来到镇上一家干净整洁的客栈，开了四间房，安顿了下来。

Hu Jiulang's fingertips gently brushed the surface of the skull, and a biting coldness came from his fingertips.

"This skull has been refined using Yinxie magic. The aura of Mo Qiwei remains on it, but it is very weak. It should be a puppet he deliberately left behind. The purpose is to lure us here, delay time, and take the opportunity to escape."

Li Erniu also came forward, shaking the copper coins in his hand a few times, mumbling something, then shook his head and said helplessly:

"He should have just left not long ago, but his breath has been completely covered, and I can't sense his specific whereabouts."

Yang Tong frowned and looked around the ruined temple, his expression becoming more serious.

"He deliberately led us to destroy the temple in order to buy time to escape. Now that the signal of the tracker has disappeared and the compass cannot locate him, it is indeed difficult to find him again. The Northeast is a vast area with many evil places. It will be difficult for us to find him wherever he finds a place to hide."

Lin Jia looked at the skull and said angrily:

"I was careless and didn't realize it was a trap, so he ran away completely."

Hu Jiulang put away the compass.

"Right now, we don't have any clues. It's just a waste of time to stay in this abandoned village. It's better to find a place to settle down first, rest and adjust on the one hand, and on the other hand, we can find ways to find traces of Moqiwei."

Li Erniu nodded.

"Yes, there is Qingfeng Town nearby. It's not too far from here. We can go to Qingfeng Town and stay there first. Then I'll ask the Immortal Chief to help sense the general direction of Mo Qiwei. Maybe we can get new clues."

Yang Tong thought for a moment.

"Okay, let's go to Qingfeng Town to settle down first. Lin Jia, you and Qian Mo go drive first, and Hu Jiulang and I will check around the ruined temple to see if we can find any clues left by Mo Qiwei."

Lin Jia and Qian Mo nodded, turned around and walked out of the ruined temple to get their cars.

Hu Jiulang and Yang Tong carefully searched the ruined temple. They did not miss the weeds in the corners or the gaps in the tables. But in the end, except for the skull, they did not find any useful clues.

Moqiwei acted extremely cautiously and left almost no traces.

At this time, Lin Jia and Qian Mo had already driven over.Hu Jiulang, Yang Tong and Li Erniu decided to go to Qingfeng Town first. Li Erniu took the skull away, and after a few people got in the car, they drove towards Qingfeng Town.

Everyone was silent along the way. The tension of the previous pursuit was gone, only the loss and solemnity of the fruitless pursuit remained.

After driving for about an hour, the car finally arrived at Qingfeng Town.

Qingfeng Town is not big, but it is very lively. The streets are lined with stalls and there is an endless stream of pedestrians. It is completely different from the desolate and abandoned villages before.

Li Erniu led everyone to a clean and tidy inn in the town, opened four rooms, and settled down.
